title: migrate pr-delivery to contract v2
goal: Adopt result_contract:2 in the pr-delivery plugin: v2 result file on every exit path, valid_verdicts declared, manifest events and result_contract, inputs resolved via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, rc∈{0,1}, and fold-in #2250 already partially in place is fully locked by the new unit test.

steps.description: Write a failing unit test (TDD first) for all v2 acceptance criteria. Cover: SPEC-1 manifest has result_contract:2 under provides:, valid_verdicts includes pass and error, events list includes pr.delivery.opened/pr.delivery.blocked/pr.delivery.dry_run, role:pr, primary:true on pr_url output, hooks has only run: (no cleanup:); SPEC-2 missing state_file → rc=1 (not 2) and pr-result.json has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=misconfigured; SPEC-3 review verdict=block guard → rc=1, result has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=complete; SPEC-4 dry-run → rc=0, result has result_contract:2, verdict=pass, disposition=complete; SPEC-5 merge delegation success → rc=0, result has result_contract:2, verdict=pass; SPEC-6 merge delegation failure → rc=1, result has result_contract:2, verdict=error; SPEC-7 pr-open delegation success → rc=0, result has result_contract:2, verdict=pass, disposition=complete; SPEC-8 pr-open returns rc=0 verdict:blocked → rc=1, result has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=complete, reason contains review_signal_missing (fold-in #2250 — locks behavior already partially coded but not yet locked by a v2 result assertion); SPEC-9 fallback gh success → rc=0, result has result_contract:2, verdict=pass; SPEC-10 fallback gh failure → rc=1, result has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=unavailable; SPEC-11 grep over plugin.sh asserts no hardcoded gate-aggregator-result.json or review-report.json path strings; SPEC-12 grep over plugin.sh asserts no hardcoded review.json path string (dead input). Confirm test FAILS at merge-base and state the red step in the PR body.

Update manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 under provides: (after role: pr); add events: list under provides: with three entries: pr.delivery.blocked, pr.delivery.opened, pr.delivery.dry_run; change valid_verdicts: [] to a YAML block list with pass and error. No router: block added — pr-delivery makes no direct LLM calls and the criterion is satisfied by its absence. No cleanup: hook — plugin holds no live resources; absence is already correct. primary:true on pr_url and role:pr are already present; no change.

Update plugin.sh: (a) add _pr_delivery_write_result helper that writes {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{branch}} via jq -nc piped through atomic_write to pr-result.json; (b) in pr_stage_run fix the missing-state_file path: change return 2 to return 1 and call _pr_delivery_write_result (verdict=error, disposition=misconfigured); (c) in _pr_stage_run_inner remove the dead review_json variable (line 51) and its guard block (lines 56-68) — review.json is not a declared manifest input per manifest comment; (d) resolve gate_aggregator_result and review_report inputs from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (jq -r '.inputs.gate_aggregator_result // empty' and '.inputs.review_report // empty') rather than constructing $artifacts_dir/gate-aggregator-result.json and $artifacts_dir/review-report.json hardcoded paths; (e) call _pr_delivery_write_result on every terminal exit path with the correct verdict/disposition/reason: review-block exit → error/complete, dry-run → pass/complete, merge-delegation success → pass/complete, merge-delegation failure → error/(disposition read from merge result or 'unavailable'), pr-open success → pass/complete, pr-open blocked → error/complete reason=review_signal_missing (the #2250 path already detects this; it now also writes the v2 result), pr-open failure → error/(disposition read from pr-open result or 'unavailable'), fallback-gh success → pass/complete, fallback-gh failure → error/unavailable. The pr-result.json writes that existed before for v1 are replaced with _pr_delivery_write_result calls, preserving any data fields (branch, pr_url, pr_number, draft) under a data: key.

Update integration test with additive v2 assertions on existing SPECs and a new SPEC-10. For SPEC-3 (dry-run): after existing assertions add: jq -r '.result_contract' pr-result.json == 2, .verdict == pass, .disposition non-empty. For SPEC-4 (block guard): add jq assertions that pr-result.json has result_contract:2, verdict=error, disposition=complete. For SPEC-5 (pr-open delegation): add jq assertion result_contract:2, verdict=pass. Add SPEC-10 for #2250 integration-level check: mock pr-open to write verdict:blocked rc=0 (no pr-url.txt); run pr_stage_run; assert rc=1, result has result_contract:2 verdict=error disposition=complete, reason contains review_signal_missing, summary does NOT contain 'delivered'. No existing assertions are removed.

notes:
1. Router block: pr-delivery makes no direct LLM calls — it delegates to merge and pr-open which carry their own router config. The 'Router budgets resolve from the manifest' acceptance criterion is satisfied by the documented absence of a router: block.
2. Dead review_json path: $artifacts_dir/review.json is NOT a declared manifest input (the manifest comment at lines 34-39 explains it was dropped when stage:review was retired). Step-3 removes this hardcoded path and its guard block entirely; the review_report declared input (review-report.json via ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS) is the surviving source.
3. valid_verdicts: [pass, error]. The dry_run path is pass (successful no-op); the block guard, missing state_file, and all failure paths are error. No skip verdict is used.
4. Fold-in #2250: the plugin already reads pr-open's verdict (lines 165-179 of current plugin.sh) and returns rc=1 on blocked. pr-delivery-blocked-test.sh (already exists) covers the behavior (P1-P4). The new unit test step-1 locks this behavior at the v2 result level (SPEC-8: result_contract:2, verdict=error, reason=review_signal_missing). Step-4 adds an integration-level SPEC-10.
5. Disposition for merge/pr-open delegation failure: read from the delegate's result file (.disposition field). If the delegate's result file is absent (plugin crashed before writing), fall back to 'unavailable'.
6. Golden diff acceptance criterion: covered by additive field assertions in step-4 on the stage's pr-result.json rather than a frozen golden fixture. A frozen golden would fail on the enriched envelope; field-level assertions serve the same verification purpose.
7. 'Reddens at the merge-base' DoD: satisfied by step-1 — the unit test is written first, confirmed red (manifest has no result_contract:2 and plugin writes no v2 result), PR body states the assertion and failure mode.
8. Coverage floor: step-1 unit test sources and exercises plugin.sh so the denominator does not grow without numerator coverage.
9. No cleanup: hook — the plugin holds no live resources; absence is the correct statement per #1829 and is already present in the current manifest.
10. pr-delivery-blocked-test.sh already exists in tests/unit/ and will continue to run alongside the new test. It is NOT replaced — it covers behavior (rc, summary text); the new test covers v2 result structure. Both are in scope.
